reason: A presentation and interface customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a Rhodes-inspired theme, animated companion, configurable visual effects, and browser-local preferences.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供罗德岛风格主题、可配置动画伴侣、界面动效和浏览器本地偏好设置。
summaries.en: Adds a Rhodes-inspired theme, configurable animated companion, interface effects, and browser-local preferences to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness Web UI presentation and terminal-style theme
Displays bundled character media and animated visual effects
Stores user preferences in browser localStorage
Uses local time, pointer proximity, clicks, focus, and UI operation state for reactions
Serves bundled media through a plugin asset route
